## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Models and reference cases concur on Benign with 0% invasive risk [F1] in the tier-1 surgical lane.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Zero invasive risk score |
| Conformal set | Benign only (alpha 10%) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; atypical embedding |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (82%–88% similarity) [F5] | Unanimous Benign reference neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-2.19 SD, contrib -1.12; 19/20 spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.35 SD, contrib -0.98; 12/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (+1.19 SD, contrib -0.53); caption inconsistent (18/20) [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.76 SD, contrib +0.45; 20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Sampled cell counts** (regions 0, 2, 4) · context · 70% neoplastic cells (96th percentile) [F7]; nuclear size CV 90th percentile [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset deletion tests (drop +0.011 vs random, 95% CI 0.002–0.020); all region risks here are 0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven in deletion tests (95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); `normal_lobules` (0/20), `mitoses` (0/20), and `necrosis` (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined atypia (regions 5, 7, 8) and 70% neoplastic cell fraction (regions 0, 2, 4) represent InSitu carcinoma.
- Simulated frozen-section appearance or 94th-percentile OOD shift masks involvement along the superior margin (83% score, region 1) [F11].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 7, 8**: Inspect duct-confined epithelium to distinguish benign hyperplasia from in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: Verify dense small nuclei (40 µm², 0th percentile [F8]) with 92nd-percentile immune proximity [F10].
3. **Regions 1, 3, 11**: Check superior margin at (768, 0) in region 1 and tubule architecture.
